ios.desc:
Transform How Ideas Evolve

SOUP is the first social-AI platform for focused, ad-free discussions. Create public or private spaces ("soups") where AI enhances civil, meaningful exchanges, and collective insights evolve in real time.

KEY FEATURES
Focused Discussions: Share concise (300-character) insights in distraction-free, AI-moderated spaces.
AI-Enhanced Insights: Build consensus, track opinion trends, and query group wisdom effortlessly.
Clean Interface: No ads. No noise. Just pure knowledge exchange.
Community Features: Follow contributors, bookmark discussions, and gain recognition for impactful ideas.

PERFECT FOR
Individuals: Share perspectives, explore new ideas, and connect with others.
Teams: Brainstorm, gather feedback, and make decisions collaboratively.
Educators: Create learning spaces, foster discussions, and gather student insights.
Researchers: Analyze trends, collect feedback, and track sentiment evolution.

7 GREAT TIPS TO USE SOUP
1. Create private or public "soup" discussion spaces by entering an opinion (at least 3 words).
2. Press the blue 'S' logo to switch between the ‘titles with questions’, and ‘concise crowd-insights.’
3. Add your opinions and watch the consensus evolve in real-time.
4. Share crowd-sourced insights both within and beyond the app.
5. Use the bubble beside the name of a "soup" creator to ask AI for insights specific to the space.
6. Click on other users to explore their published "soups" and follow those of interest.
7. Message friends and contacts by creating private "soups" that keep the consensus of conversations.

JOIN THE MOVEMENT
SOUP isn’t just an app—it’s redefining how people collaborate and share ideas. Download SOUP today and be part of a revolution in civil discourse and collaborative thinking.

COMING SOON: Premium features, end-to-end encryption, and more!

quotes.text:
Hi, I’m Gabriel from North Carolina, CEO, founder, and lead developer of SOUP, an AI-driven mobile app for civil, ad-free, public and private discussions. SOUP leverages hyper-humanized AI to moderate and synthesize conversations into actionable insights. We’re on a mission to revolutionize how ideas evolve, enabling brainstorming, feedback gathering, and real-time consensus—all without intrusive ads.

Our MVP is live on the App Store, and we’re excited to bring SOUP to a wider audience.

Download free now - https://apps.apple.com/us/app/soup-app/id6479932334

Investors: I’m currently crowdfunding on Wefunder (wefunder.com/soup), raising $200,000 (26.7% equity at a $750,000 post-money valuation) to fund SOUP’s Android version, marketing efforts, and the implementation of critical end-to-end encryption for enhanced user privacy. Visit www.sciox.ai/soup for more info!

Passionate about creating spaces where ideas thrive? DM me or check out SOUP for a fresh take on collaborative discussions!
